senses: to perceive and see, find out and discern
to know how, be skilful in
to be made known, be or become known, be revealed
(Hithpael) to make oneself known, reveal oneself

strongs.def: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
